decision.reason: The distributed case produces eight one-packet loss windows; the concentrated case produces one eight-packet loss window in both provider directions while aggregate loss and retransmission totals remain equal.
decision.residualLimitation: Sampling distinguishes concentration across 50 ms windows but does not prove packet-sequence adjacency inside one window.

operatorQuestion: Were equal aggregate packet losses concentrated in one 50 ms observation window or distributed across multiple 50 ms windows?
